svg.title: Pooja Anbalagan — GitHub profile

g.text: BSc (Hons) Data Science · Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka · 2024–2028
Data Science undergraduate building practical ML applications,
from data and evaluation to APIs, containers, and deployment.
I’m a Data Science undergraduate interested in building end-to-end machine learning systems: preparing data, testing models
rigorously, evaluating results, and integrating trained models into usable applications. My project work spans NLP and
transformer-based sentiment analysis, transfer learning for crop-disease classification, data analytics, and full-stack
I’m especially interested in the engineering that helps ML systems become reproducible and deployable, including REST APIs,
Docker, Kubernetes manifests, CI workflows, and cloud fundamentals. I’m seeking internship and early-career opportunities
across AI/ML Engineering, Data Science, MLOps, DevOps, and Cloud Engineering.
Data prep, EDA, feature engineering, statistics, dashboards
REST APIs, full-stack integration, inference workflows
Docker, Compose, Kubernetes manifests, GitHub Actions, ONNX
My experience varies by technology. Cloud, DevOps, and MLOps are active learning and project-development areas; the profile does not imply
equal proficiency across every listed tool.
An end-to-end sentiment analytics platform serving predictions from a trained text-classification pipeline
through a FastAPI backend and React/Vite frontend, with Docker, Kubernetes manifests and GitHub Actions CI.
Multi-crop plant disease classifier using MobileNetV3-Small transfer learning across 112 plant pathology
classes, exported to ONNX for CPU inference with a standalone CLI and a Node.js integration bridge.
Crowd-safety platform concept combining a FastAPI backend, React/Vite frontend, WebSockets and DBSCAN
spatial clustering to flag crowd-density risks, with rule-based alerts and safe-route suggestions.
Cloud data workflow for a customer-churn prediction group project: S3 storage, a Lambda CSV validator
triggered on upload, and CloudWatch logs for debugging. Being refined, not a finished production deployment.
PROJECT 05 · SOCIAL IMPACT · FULL-STACK WEB APP
Platform helping Sri Lankan women returning from career breaks upskill and connect with partner tech
employers. Team-built MVP with REST APIs, JWT authentication and a Prisma schema designed for PostgreSQL.
A pet-adoption platform intended to connect pets with potential adopters, built with a React frontend
styled in Tailwind CSS and a Django REST Framework backend.
An interactive dashboard analysing tourism data from 2019–2023, transforming and exploring the data
to find trends, with KPIs and visuals designed to support decision-making.
MEASURABLE · REPRODUCIBLE · TESTABLE · USEFUL BEYOND A NOTEBOOK
I’m interested in making ML work measurable, reproducible, testable, and useful beyond a notebook, with evaluation choices
that fit the problem and engineering practices that make applications easier to run and maintain.
With AgroGuard-AI, a crop-disease detection system
Rotaract Club of SUSL · leading the magazine team
Rotaract Club of SUSL · event planning and coordination
Rotaract Club, IEEE, and Computer Society events
Written and visual content for club activities
